summary: Reproduced the reported AttributeError in FunctionCallParser for qwen25 arrays containing non-object entries. Added a per-entry object check in BaseFormatDetector.parse_base_json so malformed entries are warned about and skipped without discarding valid neighboring calls, with regression and boundary coverage.

tests.what_was_measured: Seven focused tests passed, including the failing-before qwen25 mixed-array regression and independent integer, string, null, and list boundary cases.
The broader function-call parser suite passed: 250 tests and 4 subtests.
Changed Python source and regression test compile successfully.
The patch has no whitespace errors.
Static lint could not run because the prepared interpreter does not contain the ruff module.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and correction are confined to CPU-side Python JSON payload validation; no GPU kernel, numerical output, model execution, or architecture-specific path is involved.

remaining_limitations: No model weights or live serving process were needed or used; validation covers the actual FunctionCallParser path but not an HTTP request through a running server.
The prepared environment lacks ruff, so its check could not be executed.
No semantic model-generation behavior or distributed workload was tested.
